name: Santa María del Mercadillo (Spain)
description: Square light blue flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa María del Mercadillo (a castle and a sun above waves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Santa María del Mercadillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa María del Mercadillo arms — castle and sun above waves
